text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before the Takarazuka Kinen. With her 
family coming over to cheer her on, Vivlos 
was able to stay relaxed while maintaining 
just the right amount of focus.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Truly enjoying a race can teach you so 
much, too"— Vivlos shares her personal 
philosophy with her rival.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The dream of Dubai, their own pride, and 
their clan's cherished wish—carrying their 
strong feelings, the girls challenged the 
race.
